svg.aria-label: Stack layering: AICR runs as the workload on top of a Mokka substrate
svg.title: Stack layering: AICR is the workload, Mokka is the substrate
svg.desc: Five layers bottom to top: real CPU nodes; Mokka nvml-mock v0.3.0 providing the NRI plugin, mock libnvidia-ml.so.1 and mock fabric management; Kubernetes kubelet and containerd with NRI enabled; cluster software comprising GPU Operator, NVIDIA DRA driver, NFD with GFD and dcgm-exporter; and AICR recipes and validate phases on top.
svg.text: Recipes (14 components for kind + gb200 + inference)
Cluster software AICR deploys and checks
GPU Operator · NVIDIA DRA driver · NFD + GFD · dcgm-exporter
these are the real components, unmodified
NRI plugin: node-wide injection, no pod-spec change
mock libnvidia-ml.so.1, intercepting at the NVML / driver line
mock fabric management: NVSwitch topology, fabricmanager, IB subnet manager, IMEX channels
simulates fabric MANAGEMENT, not the collective data plane
CPU nodes. In this sweep: kind containers on one host.
Direction matters: AICR is the workload, Mokka is the substrate. Simulation does not live inside AICR.
